motion.name: motion
motion.purpose: Navigation and control state transitions, switch movement and the sticky draft bar entrance. Reduced motion disables them.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Save changes in the configuration workspace.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-button-primary"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 12l5 5L20 6"/></svg>Save changes</button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 38px; background: var(--accent, #226349); color: white; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #226349); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 13px; font: 570 0.88rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)), border-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #174d37; border-color: #174d37; } } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #226349); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 38px; background: white; color: var(--ink, #182822); border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #78887b); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 13px; font: 570 0.88rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)), border-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f3f7f2; border-color: #739781; } } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #226349); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Refresh status in the configuration workspace.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-text-action"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 5v6h-6m6 0a8 8 0 1 0-1 6"/></svg>Refresh status</button>
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 38px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent, #226349); border: 0; border-radius: 7px; padding: 5px 6px; font: 570 0.88rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)), border-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-text-action:hover { background: #e9f0e9; } } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #226349); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text-action { transition: none; } }

components.name: Access token field
components.description: The masked host access field has a visible label.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-token">Access token</label><input class="ds-token" id="ds-token" type="password" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" required>
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 600 1rem/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #182822); } .ds-token { width: 100%; min-height: 39px; padding: 8px 10px; margin-top: 6px; font: 0.93rem/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #182822); background: white; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #78887b); border-radius: 6px; caret-color: var(--accent, #226349); } .ds-token:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #226349); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 540px) { .ds-token { font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Current section
components.description: The selected section of the desktop rail.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav" type="button" aria-current="page"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 5h6v5H4zM14 14h6v5h-6zM7 10v5a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h5M10 7h7v4"/></svg>Execution</button>
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 39px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--tint, #dfece3); color: #194e35; font: 630 0.94rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion, 155ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.7, 0.25, 1)); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-nav:hover { background: #e9f0e9; } } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #226349); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav { transition: none; } }

components.name: Preview workspace
components.description: Display only when the host signals preview mode.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 5px; font: 600 0.76rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; background: #f5ebd9; color: #70501d; }

components.name: Revision review panel
components.description: The base and newer host revisions precede conflict details.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 23px 24px; color: var(--ink, #182822); background: white; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e1db); border-radius: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.22rem; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.023em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #586b61); line-height: 1.5; } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-panel { padding: 20px; } } @media (max-width: 540px) { .ds-panel { padding: 17px; } }

narrative.overview: AgentHub opens with a four-step task guide at /configure. First-time users choose an AI service, a place to give requests and a dedicated work folder, then check and apply their choices. The saved browser inbox accepts natural-language tasks, pairs each request with its reply and offers an optional connection test. Advanced settings remain one action away, including a direct /configure#advanced bookmark. Both views retain their own draft while the tab stays open.
dos: Show whether a value comes from the saved host revision or the editable draft.
Keep the operator’s edits available across section and language changes.
donts: Never use a health dot or color change as the only status message.
Never present history restoration or conflict resolution as a completed save.
